questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of angle that has a measure less than 90°?
questions.solution: An acute angle is defined as an angle that measures less than 90°. A right angle measures exactly 90°, a straight angle measures 180°, and an obtuse angle measures more than 90° but less than 180°.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कोण का प्रकार है जिसका माप 90° से कम होता है?
hi.solution: एक न्यून कोण को एक कोण के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है जिसका माप 90° से कम होता है। एक समकोण का माप ठीक 90° होता है, एक सीधा कोण का माप 180° होता है, और एक अधिक कोण का माप 90° से अधिक लेकिन 180° से कम होता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in Indian curriculum.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणता कोन हा 90° पेक्षा कमी माप असतो?

questions.stem: What is the term used to describe the point where two arms of an angle meet?
questions.solution: The point where two arms of an angle meet is called the vertex. This is a fundamental geometric definition. The other options refer to different parts of an angle, such as the sides or the figure itself, but not the meeting point.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a model for a line?
choices: A ray of light from a torch
A line segment between two points
A line extending infinitely in both directions
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'A line extending infinitely in both directions' because a line, as defined in the chapter, has no endpoints and extends infinitely. A dot represents a point, a ray has one endpoint, and a line segment has two endpoints. Hence, only the infinite line fits the definition.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a model for a ray?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct definition of a right angle?
choices: An angle that is less than 90°
An angle that is more than 90° but less than 270°
questions.solution: A right angle is defined as an angle that is exactly 90°, which is a standard geometric definition. Angles less than 90° are classified as acute, not right angles. Angles between 90° and 180° are obtuse, and angles exactly 180° are straight angles, not right angles.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to compare two angles by placing one over the other?
questions.solution: Superimposition is the correct method because it involves placing one angle over another to directly compare their sizes. Measurement uses tools like protractors to determine angle sizes numerically. Counting and estimation do not provide accurate comparisons of angles.

questions.stem: How many lines can be drawn passing through a single point?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Infinite' because, in geometry, a line is defined as extending endlessly in both directions, and there is no restriction on the number of lines that can pass through a single point. Any number of lines can be drawn through the same point, making the number of possible lines unbounded.

questions.stem: If two angles are superimposed and their arms overlap completely, what can be said about the angles?
questions.solution: When two angles are superimposed and their arms overlap completely, the angles must have the same measure, making them equal. Supplementary angles add up to 180 degrees, and complementary angles add up to 90 degrees, which is not necessarily true here. questions.stem: If two angles are formed by the same vertex and their sum is 180°, what type of angle pair is this?
questions.solution: Supplementary angles are two angles whose measures add up to 180°, which matches the condition given in the question. Complementary angles add up to 90°, not 180°, so they are incorrect. Vertical angles are formed when two lines intersect and are always equal, but their sum is not necessarily 180°. Adjacent angles share a common side but do not always add up to 180°, so they are not the correct answer.

questions.stem: In a clock, what is the angle between the hour and minute hands at 3:00?
questions.solution: At 3:00, the hour hand is at 3 and the minute hand is at 12. Each hour mark represents 30°, so the angle between 3 and 12 is 3 × 30° = 90°. The other options do not represent the correct calculation based on the clock's structure.

questions.stem: How many degrees are in an angle that is one-sixth of a full turn?
questions.solution: A full turn is 360°, and one-sixth of 360° is 60°. The correct answer is 60°. 30° is one-twelfth of a full turn, 45° is one-eighth, and 90° is one-fourth.
